notes: Tour 6033 (KL-Y-BL08), an 8-day high-speed rail tour (vehicle_name 西九, vehicle_type 3) to Yunnan. Detail and dates captured 2026-11-14 13:15 UTC (21:15 Hong Kong), trimmed by public.ts.
